introducer.title: Fix nb stickyscroll not having outline if outline pane is closed

cases.mechanism: NotebookStickyScroll could be disposed while computeFullSymbols was pending. Its dispose method disposes _disposables, but the old continuation then added outline/editor/scroll listeners to that dead store; DisposableStore.add leaves such listeners undisposed, allowing event emitters to retain the sticky-scroll object.
cases.symptom: Closing a notebook during asynchronous symbol computation could retain sticky-scroll listeners and their UI/model closure, accumulating memory and future callback work.
cases.fixedBehavior: The new post-computation disposed check returns before content creation and all listener registrations.
cases.evidence: RIGHT line 217 checks this._store.isDisposed immediately after computeFullSymbols. The old path continued to base line 222, the first _disposables listener registration; the class dispose method disposes _disposables before super.dispose, and lifecycle.ts confirms subsequent add calls leak rather than self-dispose. Blame resolves the commit that introduced this post-await listener setup.
